edgeAATolerance.reason: Measured on CI 39583112762 (issue #60 pass 3; 3 identical runs, gamma-sRGB interpolation: max 48, mean 21.4, 28% over 32). macOS 27 interpolates gradients perceptually (Oklab); GradientRaster now does too. Simulated residual of the Oklab raster against the Mac capture over all 8 cells (rows, 45 degree diagonals, 2- and 3-stop, rounded-corner coverage from the Windows capture): max 29 levels, mean 7.1, 0 pixels over 32, 0 outside the band. Tolerance = measured plus margin. The residual is a colour-model difference not explained by Oklab, CIELAB, IPT, ICtCp, wide-gamut or power-law variants (Mac is slightly darker mid-gradient and bends near saturated orange/blue), plus +-1 dither on the Mac; tighten if the model is identified. Geometry (stop mapping, 45 degree corner-to-corner lines) matches exactly.
